coordinator_decision.context: Interpret the two completed canonical five-bit SGCP embedding runs without widening their frozen claim boundary.
rationale: The locked generator and independent verifier both completed valid with exact committed-predecessor linkage and every post-run check true.
A coordinate-compatible injective formal order ideal exists for each frozen B row with nonzero constrained density and retained final support.
The full-support balanced-only baseline fails the required algebraic axioms, while the canonical-closure baseline defines no embedding.
The valid optimizer sacrifices final support from 23/23 to 13/23, 7/23, and 7/23, making the expansion-versus-consistency tradeoff the next uncertainty to test.
limitations: One five-bit curve, one seed, and three factor-base sizes do not establish family-level or asymptotic behavior.
The factor-base sizes are not a cryptographic n^(1/5) scaling sweep.
Optimizer work is exhaustive and nonmonotone; no fitted complexity exponent is justified.
Private optimizer and literal witness maps are charged audit material, not free attack advice.
No relation probability, matrix rank, individual logarithm, preprocessing crossover, or rho improvement was measured.
next_actions: Write a fresh multi-curve SGCP density-and-expansion contract with matched coordinate controls and explicit optimizer gaps.
